description: This file contains the implementation of the BasketViewModelService class, which provides methods to handle basket-related operations such as retrieving, creating, and mapping basket data for the e-commerce web application.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that provides basket-related operations such as retrieving, mapping, and creating baskets for users in the e-commerce application.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the existing basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for the specified user and returns its view model.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Retrieves detailed basket item view models, including product information and images, given a collection of basket items.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket domain entity to its corresponding BasketViewModel, including basket items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total count of items across a user's basket.
